headline: Bitcoin Rebounds 8% to $59,952 After Sliding to Two-Year Lows
summary: Bitcoin rebounded over 8% to approximately $59,952, briefly touching $60,000 after dropping to a two-year low of $55,251.60 earlier in the session following a break below $57,742.
why: Bitcoin is the benchmark digital asset, indicating broader retail and institutional liquidity and speculative risk appetite across crypto markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin staged an 8% recovery back toward $60,000 following deep oversold conditions near $55,251.
